title: Short exact complex comparison for arbitrary single-module union base change
statement: Let p:Y→B and g:A→B be arbitrary morphisms of schemes, U,V arbitrary opens of Y, and N an O_(U union V)-module. Use the standard derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Write a for standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U union V).ι ≫ p) N g [def-pc-standard-single-base-change-map], and aU,aV,aUV for the analogous comparisons of the literal tensor pullbacks of N [def-pc-module-pullback] along the inclusions of U,V,U intersection V into their union. There exist short complexes P,P′ of cochain complexes of O_A-modules [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], a morphism m:P→P′, and isomorphisms e1,e2,e3 from Q(P1),Q(P2),Q(P3) to a.left,aU.left biproduct aV.left,aUV.left, and e1′,e2′,e3′ from Q(P1′),Q(P2′),Q(P3′) to a.right,aU.right biproduct aV.right,aUV.right. Both P and P′ are short exact. The three identities are Q(m1)≫e1′.hom=e1.hom≫a.hom, Q(m2)≫e2′.hom=e2.hom≫biprod.map(aU.hom,aV.hom), and Q(m3)≫e3′.hom=e3.hom≫aUV.hom. There are no quasi-coherence, relative flatness, compactness or invertibility hypotheses or conclusions. No connecting morphisms or distinguished triangles are asserted.

proof.text: Resolve N[0] on W=U union V and its ordinary pullback on W_A by K-injective complexes with injective terms. Apply the unrestricted injective Mayer–Vietoris presentation to the induced covers. The sheaf equalizer condition and flasqueness give the short exact restriction-difference rows. No open is required to be compact.

Apply derived direct image to the cover rows and derived pullback on the source side. Represent the finite cover diagrams and their maps by diagram resolutions. Transpose the ordinary pullback map under the derived adjunction; restriction-unit naturality gives the first square, and the difference of the two nested restriction squares gives the second. The degreewise open counit identity identifies the cover comparison. With these specified homotopies rectify the first square and use the functorial cylinder short exact rows C→D⊕Cone(id C)→Cone(t). Their first and middle vertices localize to C and D, and the overlap comparison identifies the cone vertex. This gives the strict short exact rows P,P′ and m.

Transport the six vertices by derived direct-image composition, exact open restriction, and the additive biproduct comparison. The coefficient restrictions identify with the displayed literal tensor pullbacks. Expanding the comparison as the mate of the pulled-back counit, the composite-counit and triangle identities identify the three maps with the union comparison, the biproduct of the member comparisons, and the overlap comparison. These are the displayed conjugacy identities. Empty, repeated or contained opens give zero or split restriction rows; zero modules are included. All witnesses are existential and define no library data.

lean.statement:
theorem standardSingle_union_ses_presentation
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens)
    (N : (U ⊔ V).toScheme.Modules) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    let a := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊔ V).ι ≫ p) N g)
    let aU := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (U.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_left) N) g)
    let aV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap (V.ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE le_sup_right) N) g)
    let aUV := Arrow.mk (standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ p)
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (Y.homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left)) N) g)
    ∃ (P P' : ShortComplex (CochainComplex
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings A.toRingedSpace)) ℤ))
      (m : P ⟶ P')
      (e₁ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₁ ≅ a.left)
      (e₂ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₂ ≅ aU.left ⊞ aV.left)
      (e₃ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.X₃ ≅ aUV.left)
      (e₁' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₁ ≅ a.right)
      (e₂' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₂ ≅ aU.right ⊞ aV.right)
      (e₃' : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P'.X₃ ≅ aUV.right),
      P.ShortExact ∧ P'.ShortExact ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₁ ≫ e₁'.hom = e₁.hom ≫ a.hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₂ ≫ e₂'.hom = e₂.hom ≫ biprod.map aU.hom aV.hom ∧
      DerivedCategory.Q.map m.τ₃ ≫ e₃'.hom = e₃.hom ≫ aUV.hom
